title: Verbose error messages on login endpoint
summary: The login endpoint returns a stack trace on malformed input in the lab environment.
remediation: Return a generic error message and log details server-side only.

title: Default credentials on lab admin panel
summary: The synthetic admin panel accepted the documented default credentials.
impact: In the lab scenario this would grant full administrative control.
remediation: Force a credential change on first login and disable default accounts.

title: Missing security headers on static site
summary: Content-Security-Policy and X-Frame-Options were absent in the lab build.
